stories.headline: Fresno man sentenced to 62 years to life for trafficking two teenage girls
stories.summary: A Fresno County judge sentenced a 38-year-old man to 62 years to life in prison on 27 August, after a jury convicted him of human trafficking, pimping and pandering.

stories.headline: New Colorado Springs child-trafficking task force makes its first arrests
stories.summary: A newly formed FBI-led child exploitation and human trafficking task force in southern Colorado announced its first arrests on 28 August, following a July undercover sting.
